# Renewity Residential Care Home for Seniors

> A home-style congregate care home (residential care home) for seniors in New Albany, Indiana — not a skilled nursing facility.

Renewity provides non-medical, home-style assisted living and memory care for seniors in a residential setting. The home is located at 3755 St Joseph Road, New Albany, IN 47150, and serves New Albany, Floyd County, and the surrounding Southern Indiana area.

Contact: (812) 725-1660 · michele@renewityassistedliving.com
